name: thermos-claude-plugin-tooling
description: Maintainer tooling for the thermos-claude-plugin repository. Not part of the plugin.

scripts.test:linux: docker run --rm --init -v .:/src:ro node:24-bookworm bash -c "mkdir /w && tar -C /src --exclude=./node_modules --exclude=./.stryker-tmp --exclude=./.claude/worktrees -cf - . | tar -C /w -xf - && cd /w && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm test"
scripts.mutate: stryker run && stryker run stryker.test-each.config.mjs && stryker run stryker.test-code.config.mjs
